scenario.goal: Cleaner 1% lows and fewer spikes while OBS and Discord stay clean

findings.title: Less junk running
findings.detail: Sample workload shows 136 background processes. Launchers, browser helpers, overlays, and vendor utilities are competing during gameplay.

findings.title: OBS setup stays safe
findings.detail: Capture, voice, and stream stability stay protected while the game gets more room.

findings.title: Drivers stay manual
findings.detail: Driver installers, DDU, NVCleanstall, and NVIDIA settings stay locked until hardware match and user confirmation.

recommendedActions.label: Tune My PC
recommendedActions.reason: Give the game more room while OBS and Discord stay protected.

recommendedActions.label: Check startup junk
recommendedActions.reason: Overlays, launchers, and vendor updaters are likely background workload contributors.

recommendedActions.label: Check driver path
recommendedActions.reason: Driver choice should prioritize stability and lows, not only newest version.
